prompt: When may packing of the model resume?
promptZh: 這個機種何時可以恢復包裝？

options.whyZh: stop packing ... until 表示在新內襯到貨以前暫停；到貨是恢復包裝的前提。

options.text: As soon as the labels are reprinted.
options.whyZh: 標籤本來就正確，沒有要求重印。

options.text: After a larger model is designed.
options.whyZh: 對話在處理小型機種包裝，沒有要求改設計更大產品。

options.text: When the outer cartons are painted.
options.whyZh: 沒有外箱上漆作業，改善重點是泡棉內襯。

explanationZh: stop packing ... until 表示在新內襯到貨以前暫停；到貨是恢復包裝的前提。
evidence: Do not pack that model again until the new inserts arrive.

vocabulary.note: 暫停後重新開始某項作業。
